source: Approved simplified enemy kobolds from Design kobold variants, 2026-10-01

events.enter: Reuse idle; enemies do not travel between rooms
events.reducedMotion: Static action/hurt/defeat poses; no lunge, bob, shake or projectile

prompts.prompt: Create a production animation sprite sheet derived from this EXACT approved simplified enemy kobold. Preserve its identity, colors, outfit, claws, horns, large ears, curled tail, menacing face, simplified low-detail style with no spots and minimal shading. Landscape 1536x1024 transparent PNG, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows of equally sized 512x512 cells. NO lines or labels. Each cell has ONE complete full-body kobold facing LEFT in three-quarter view, same body proportions and scale across cells, head height about 170 pixels, standing full-body height about 360 pixels, ground baseline at local y=450, generous padding on every side. All weapons tails horns feet wholly inside each own cell, no overlaps or fragments from adjacent cells. Left-to-right top row: 1 idle menacing ready stance, 2 attack anticipation winding up, 3 attack action extending toward LEFT. Left-to-right bottom row: 4 recovery returning guard, 5 hurt recoiling slightly backward, 6 defeated slumped low seated with eyes closed, gear still held and tail visible. Defeat is non-graphic. Do not add decorative details, particles, scenery, floor, shadows, text, branding. True transparency. Spear skirmisher: anticipation draws the spear back, action thrusts spear toward LEFT with both hands gripping shaft. Keep the entire short spear inside every cell.

repairPrompt: Repair ONLY the sprite sheet layout. Preserve all six existing poses and their character design, colors, face, outfit and flat simplified detail. Keep image 1536x1024, 3 columns and 2 rows with 512x512 cells. SCALE EVERY FIGURE DOWN to about 70% of its current size, independently center each FULL figure in its own cell. All standing poses share feet baseline local y=430. Every part of each character including long weapons must have at least 60px transparent margin to its own cell edges. Very important: top right action figure must fit ENTIRELY inside x=1084..1476 and y=60..450, with no spear or hand extending into middle cell. Lower middle figure must fit entirely inside x=572..964 and y=572..962. Every figure is fully isolated with wide transparent gutters between all 6 figures. Do not clip or shorten any equipment, do not add content. True transparent background, no colored mist, no floor, no shadows, no panels or labels.
